selection_rule: With pinned VPS source caches, retain the two prior untouched Flipt Go pairs, then take the two lexicographically first NodeBB JavaScript task IDs not referenced in prior G02 evidence whose base commits exist in the pinned nodebb cache. Read source-only columns only until all prospective predictions are sealed.
decision_rule: Run and report both NodeBB tasks even if the first fails. A broad fixed-candidate G02 quality claim requires both NodeBB pairs scoreable and all four strict gates on each; any unscored arm is inconclusive for that pair, not a win. Keep raw-model and selected scores separate. Do not claim full ContextBench generalization from four tasks.
gold_posture: No gold columns or native scoring for a prospective task until both of its predictions and costs are sealed.
open_questions: Will the fixed candidate survive two NodeBB tasks?
How much of the selector gain persists outside Flipt?
